dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan official plan Major Transit Station Areas (Planned).  Planned Major Transit Station Areas identify the locations planned higher-order transit stations that serve as focal points for transit-oriented development, mobility connections, and intensified urban growth. These areas support walkable access to regional and local transit networks.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
dct_title_s: Brampton Plan-Planned Major Transit Station Areas
